final_message:
I implemented `parseSeries` (`src/series.ts`), `MetricsClient` (`src/client.ts`), and `evaluateRule` and `findIncidents` (`src/rules.ts`), following the README.

All 11 offline tests pass. The one remaining failure is `reads the live queue_depth series`, which calls the real `metrics.ops.internal` service and fails with `fetch failed` because this sandbox has no network. It will fail in CI for the same reason. I left that test unchanged; it needs either network access or a skip when offline.
